events.description: 12. ORDER: Pro se plaintiffs filed the complaint and paid the filing fee in this action on April 1, 2024. ECF Nos. 1, 2 . Plaintiffs shall have 90 days from April 1, 2024 to serve defendants and file proof of proper service with the Court. Accordingly, if proper service is not made upon defendants by July 1, 2024, or if plaintiffs fail to show good cause why such service has not been effected by that date, I shall recommend that the Court should dismiss this action without prejudice. See attached Order. Ordered by Magistrate Judge Lois Bloom on 4/4/2024. (VP) (Entered: 04/04/2024)

events.description: 17. Minute Entry for proceedings held before District Judge Ramon E. Reyes, Jr: Pre Motion Conference held on 4/10/2024.Case called. Discussions held. The Court received Exhibit 1 as described on the record, attached hereto with private addresses redacted. Plaintiffs 16 Motion for emergency relief and a Temporary Restraining Order is denied for the reasons stated on the record. By 4/15/2024, formal oppositions to 3 Motion for Preliminary Injunction shall be filed by Defendants. Each opposition brief shall also include any Motions to Dismiss the Complaint. Plaintiffs shall file any additional evidence, including affidavits, and any supplemental briefing they choose to make in support of their 3 Motion for Preliminary Injunction by 4/15/2024. Any replies must be made by 4/22/2024. Plaintiffs are reminded to submit a form consenting to electronic service and return it to the Pro Se Office. Defendants are ordered to electronically send Plaintiffs a copy of this Minute Entry at the email addresses included in ECF No. 15 . (Court Reporter Victoria Torres-Butler.) (ENE) (Entered: 04/12/2024)

events.description: ORDER granting 26 Motion for Extension of Time. Plaintiffs may file an amended complaint by May 6, 2024, pursuant to Federal Rules of Civil Procedure 15(a). The Court is in receipt of the material submitted by Plaintiffs at ECF Nos. 24, 25, 26, 28, 29, 31, and 32, and will consider these materials as filed in support of the pending Motion for a Preliminary Injunction, which has not yet been decided. Should the parties wish to file additional material, either in support of or in opposition to the Motion for Preliminary Injunction, they shall do so by Monday, April 22, 2024. The Court will proceed to consideration of the Preliminary Injunction Motion thereafter. Counsel for the Defendants are hereby ORDERED to email a copy of this order to the Plaintiffs at the emails listed at ECF No. 15. Ordered by District Judge Ramon E. Reyes, Jr on 4/18/2024. (MH)
